snippet.title: RKR - Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
With your head, name and purpose taken from you, the only thing that keeps you going is your unquenchable rage... and quickly draining blood. Reclaim what is yours before your blood runs dry.

Releasing on Steam on September 30th is an action-packed indie roguelike where your goal is to kill all that stands in your way, as quick as possible.

CHECK THE GAME OUT ON STEAM:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2137680/RKR__Rush_Kill_Repeat/

PLAY THE GAME DURING THE MONTH OF OCTOBER TO UNLOCK A SPECIAL HALLOWEEN MODE!

The game's chiptune soundtrack was composed by the incredible Biuuuwulf:
https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC2IJwflKHKvWNAEa_dfowqg

RKR was created using GameMaker: Studio for a game jam in 2020.

#roguelike #indie #gamemaker
